summary: Ran 14 pytest backend tests (all passing) covering auth (login/register/me/lockout), settings CRUD, task CRUD, task lifecycle (queued->running->completed), and the run_python approval flow (queued->awaiting_approval->approve->completed). Executed Playwright UI tests against desktop 1920x1080: verified login with admin creds, three-pane workspace loads with agent console/live-screen/task-control, simple goal streams via SSE with Running->Completed status badge transition, execution steps + timeline update, agent loop stage indicators (OBSERVE/PLAN/ACT/VERIFY/COMPLETE) present, high-risk goal ('Use Python to compute first 10 primes') pauses with approval-card showing Allow Once/Allow Always/Reject and code snippet, Allow Once resumes and completes, history sheet lists prior tasks, theme toggle works, user menu shows Settings/About/Sign out.

issues: DialogContent missing aria-describedby / Description prop (a11y warning in console)

action_items: (Optional) Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to Radix DialogContent components in AboutDialog/SettingsDialog/HistorySheet to remove console a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py sets cookies with SameSite=None/Secure – correct for cross-site preview, good.
server.py CORS allow_origins uses a single FRONTEND_URL – fine but consider list-typing for multi-env.
server.py public_task mutates the input dict then still stores original via dict(doc) – safe due to copy on insert but a bit fragile; okay.
SSE endpoint reads user from cookie/header – matches EventSource withCredentials pattern; good.
auth.py brute-force lockout works but uses ip:email key; sufficient for MVP.
seed_data_creation: Admin auto-seeded on backend startup. Test tasks created with TEST_ prefix during pytest run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend + frontend fully working end-to-end. SSE streaming verified via UI. Only minor a11y console warning for missing DialogDescription. Approval flow (run_python) confirmed working through UI. Web-search CSV artifact flow not explicitly tested in UI due to time (each real-browser task takes 30-90s), but the underlying tools & artifact endpoint are exercised via backend tests and product owner note.
